Face confidence hint: 0.5 to 1. E.g. 0.8; at 0.9, fewer false faces (patterns, statues) but more missed faces (profiles, hidden faces).
Face sharpness hint: 0 to 2000. E.g. 50: a sharp face often measures 100 to 300, a blurred or shaken face under 30.
Face auto threshold hint: 0.2 to 1. E.g. 0.50: two photos of the same person usually match at 0.6 to 0.9, two different people under 0.4.
Face suggestion threshold hint: 0.2 to 1, below automatic attribution. E.g. 0.36: between 0.36 and 0.50, the person is only suggested ("to confirm").
Face margin hint: 0 to 0.5. E.g. 0.05: a face at 0.62 for Paul and 0.59 for Pierre (gap of 0.03) is only suggested, never attributed automatically.
